name: BookAppointment
description: Book an appointment with a specific doctor for the given date and time. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: FindProvider
description: Find a medical service provider based on their location and speciality. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: delete_contact
description: This tool permanently removes a contact from the user's contact list by name. It is important to note that once a contact is deleted, it cannot be recovered.

required_parameters.name: contact_name
required_parameters.description: The full name of the contact to be deleted from the user's contact list.

result_parameters.name: deletion_status
result_parameters.description: A message confirming whether the contact has been successfully deleted or an error message if the deletion could not be processed.

name: delete_contact_number
description: This tool is designed to remove a phone number from a specified contact's detail within the user's contact list. It allows for precise deletion based on the phone number itself or its order among multiple numbers.

optional_parameters.name: contact_name
optional_parameters.description: The name of the contact from whom the phone number is to be deleted. The full name is required.

optional_parameters.name: contact_number
optional_parameters.description: The specific phone number to be deleted. If provided, this number is directly targeted for deletion.

optional_parameters.name: number_order
optional_parameters.description: If the contact has multiple numbers and no specific number is provided, this parameter specifies the order of the number to delete (e.g., the first number, second number, etc.).

result_parameters.name: deletion_status
result_parameters.description: Confirms the successful removal of the phone number or provides details if the operation couldn't be completed.

name: delete_contact_email
description: This tool deletes an email address associated with a specified contact in the user's contact list. This action is irreversible, and the email address cannot be retrieved once deleted.

optional_parameters.name: contact_name
optional_parameters.description: The full name of the contact whose email address is to be deleted.

optional_parameters.name: contact_email
optional_parameters.description: The specific email address to be deleted, if known. If not provided, the default operation will assume the only or primary email is to be deleted.

optional_parameters.name: email_order
optional_parameters.description: Specifies the order of the email address to be deleted if the contact has multiple email addresses. For example, '1' for the primary email, '2' for the secondary, and so on.

result_parameters.name: deletion_status
result_parameters.description: Confirms the successful removal of the email address or informs about any issues that prevented the deletion.

name: update_contact_information
description: This tool allows for the modification of existing contact information or add more contact details within a user's contact list, such as updating a contact name, phone number, or email address.

required_parameters.name: name
required_parameters.description: The original name of the contact as currently stored in the contact list.

required_parameters.name: new_information
required_parameters.description: An object containing the new contact details that need to be updated.

new_name.description: The new name to assign to the contact, if changing the contact's name.

new_phone_number.description: The new phone number to be added to the contact list.

new_email.description: The new email to be added to the contact list.

optional_parameters.name: phone_number
optional_parameters.description: The original phone number of the contact that needs to be replaced.

optional_parameters.name: email
optional_parameters.description: The original email number of the contact that needs to be replaced.

result_parameters.name: update_status
result_parameters.description: Confirms the successful update of the contact's information or informs about any issues that prevented the update.

name: add_new_contact
description: This tool allows for the creation of a brand-new contact entry in the user's contact list, using the provided personal information such as name, phone number, email address, and potentially a physical address.

required_parameters.name: contact_name
required_parameters.description: The full name of the new contact to be added to the contact list.

required_parameters.name: phone_number
required_parameters.description: The phone number associated with the new contact.

optional_parameters.name: email
optional_parameters.description: The email address of the new contact, if available.

optional_parameters.name: address
optional_parameters.description: The physical address of the new contact.

result_parameters.name: creation_status
result_parameters.description: Confirms the successful creation of the new contact or provides details if there were any issues during the process.

name: search_contact
description: This tool searches the user's contact list for a specific contact based on provided search criteria such as the contact's name, phone number, or email address.

optional_parameters.name: contact_name
optional_parameters.description: The full name or partial name of the contact to search for.

optional_parameters.name: phone_number
optional_parameters.description: The phone number of the contact to search for.

optional_parameters.name: email
optional_parameters.description: The email address of the contact to search for.

result_parameters.name: contact_name
result_parameters.description: The full name or partial name of the contact to search for.

result_parameters.name: phone_number
result_parameters.description: The phone number of the contact to search for.

result_parameters.name: email
result_parameters.description: The email address of the contact to search for.

name: get_current_temperature
description: Retrieves the current ambient temperature from a specified location, such as a room, building, or outdoor environment.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: The specified location, such as a room, building, or outdoor environment from where the current ambient temperature is to be retrieved.

result_parameters.name: temperature
result_parameters.description: The current ambient temperature at the specified location.

name: check_door_status
description: Queries the status of a door to determine if it is currently open or closed, and may provide additional security information.

required_parameters.name: door_location
required_parameters.description: The location of the door that the user wants to check the status of

result_parameters.name: door_status
result_parameters.description: The current status of the door: locked or unlocked

name: play_music
description: Initiates the playback of music on a connected audio system, including options to select playlists, songs, or streaming services.

required_parameters.name: song/playlist
required_parameters.description: The specific song or playlist that the user wants to play.

optional_parameters.name: volume
optional_parameters.description: The volume at which the music should be played.

optional_parameters.name: music_service
optional_parameters.description: The specific music or streaming service, e.g. Spotify.

optional_parameters.name: location
optional_parameters.description: The location where the user wants the music to be played.

optional_parameters.name: music_genre
optional_parameters.description: The specific genre of music the user wants to play.

result_parameters.name: confirmation
result_parameters.description: A confirmation message that the music has been played as per user's instruction.

name: lock_door
description: Commands a smart lock to secure a door, ensuring the door is locked and reporting the lock status.

required_parameters.name: door_name
required_parameters.description: The name or location of the door that needs to be locked

result_parameters.name: lock_status
result_parameters.description: The status of the door lock after the 'lock_door' action

name: adjust_room_temperature
description: Controls the thermostat or heating/cooling system to set a specific temperature for a room or area.

required_parameters.name: temperature
required_parameters.description: The desired temperature to set the thermostat or heating/cooling system to.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: The specific room or area where the temperature should be adjusted.

result_parameters.name: confirmation
result_parameters.description: A confirmation message that the temperature has been set as per user's instruction.

name: adjust_lighting
description: Modifies the lighting conditions in a specified area, which can include dimming, color changes, or turning lights on or off.

required_parameters.name: location
required_parameters.description: Specifies the area where the lighting conditions are to be modified

required_parameters.name: action
required_parameters.description: Determines the action to be executed on the specified lighting conditions such as turning on or off lights or dimming

optional_parameters.name: intensity
optional_parameters.description: Represents the level of brightness to be set if the lights are to be dimmed or brightened

result_parameters.name: status
result_parameters.description: Returns the status of the action performed on the specified lighting conditions

name: adjust_music_volume
description: Changes the volume of the music currently being played on a connected audio system.

required_parameters.name: volume
required_parameters.description: A numerical representation of the desired music volume

result_parameters.name: confirmation
result_parameters.description: Confirmation message that the volume adjustment has been made accordingly

name: GetWeather
description: Get the weather of a certain location on a date. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.
